text: Sometimes a client asks to cancel a mail item after the mail team has started. The CL asks; the mail team decides.
On Juniper's visit bill, the heartworm chewable is already filled in the mail queue.
add a note for the mail team,
The bill shows it's waiting on the mail team.
In the queue, Cancel requests shows it. Check it first thing.
Open it to see who asked, and why.
Choose what fits: cancel and refund, cancel without a refund, already shipped, or keep the order.
It's filled but not shipped, and the bill was paid, so cancel and refund.
Scout opens the return on the bill. Back on the shelf is ticked, so it goes back into stock.
It was paid in cash, so the refund goes on Maria's account as credit. A card payment would go back to the card. Confirm it.
Returned. The bill now shows the refund.
The most common mistakes: pulling the item off the bill after the mail team started, and leaving cancel requests waiting.
Remember: once the mail team has started, request the cancellation. The mail team decides, first thing each day.
